description: Pitch and mating table. PITCH IS THE FACT; the family name is marketing. Vendors label 1.25 mm parts 'SH1.25' although JST's own SH series is 1.0 mm, so bom_lint treats a pitch mismatch as an error and a family-name mismatch at equal pitch as a warning.
mating_rule: Two connectors mate only if pitch and pin count both match and the genders are complementary. Nothing else is sufficient. Polarity is a separate question and is never standardised - meter it.

JST-PH.typical_use: LiPo cell leads on Adafruit/SparkFun boards, generic hobby battery leads
JST-PH.note: The single most common connector mistake in hobby builds: a PH 2.0 cell lead will not enter a 1.25 mm socket.

JST-SH.typical_use: Qwiic/STEMMA QT I2C, small sensor links such as the Heltec QuickLink (SH1.0-4P)

SH1.25.typical_use: Small LiPo cells and many ESP32 dev-board battery inputs, including the Heltec E290 JP1 (SH1.25-2P)
SH1.25.note: Labelled 'SH' by most sellers even though JST's SH series is 1.0 mm. Treat the 1.25 mm pitch as the fact.

JST-GH.typical_use: Locking 1.25 mm connector, common on flight controllers
JST-GH.note: Same pitch as SH1.25 but has a latch. Mechanically will often mate; do not rely on it.

JST-XH.typical_use: Balance leads on multi-cell packs, general-purpose wiring

DuPont.note: Not a retention system. Fine on the bench, unreliable in anything that moves.

solder_pad.typical_use: Speakers, motors, piezo discs, cells with bare leads
solder_pad.note: Mates with nothing; it is a permanent joint. Plan the assembly order around it, because it is irreversible without rework.

U.FL.note: Rated for a small number of mating cycles and easy to damage. Fit the pigtail once and leave it.

cross_plug_guidance: Deliberately choosing DIFFERENT pitches for different nets is a design virtue: it makes cross-plugging physically impossible. The Heltec E290 does this - the battery is 1.25 mm and the QuickLink sensor bus is 1.0 mm, so the two cannot be swapped. bom_lint credits this and flags its absence when two different nets share one connector type.

awg_current.note: Chassis-wiring style guidance for short hobby runs in still air. Derate for bundles, long runs and high ambient temperature.
